# Comfy Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite- Image to Video

Generate short videos from a single still image using Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite, a faster, lower-cost model that turns one image into a video clip up to 15 seconds at resolutions up to 1080p. Ideal for rapid social content, storyboard previews, and high-volume creative iteration where speed and cost matter more than maximum fidelity. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_grok_imagine_video_1_5_lite_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: High-fashion editorial video, vibrant pop-art studio portrait. A model in an oversized fluffy faux-fur headpiece of turquoise, lavender-purple, and white, with round gold-rimmed blue mirrored sunglasses, glossy pink lips, and bare shoulders against a seamless hot magenta backdrop. She slowly tilts her chin upward and turns her head slightly to the side with confident, elegant poise. A soft wind machine sweeps the long fur, which ripples and flutters in silky, flowing waves, individual strands catching the light. Her lips part gently into a subtle, cool expression. Studio light glides across the mirrored lenses, creating a sleek reflective glint that sweeps from one lens to the other. The camera performs a smooth, slow push-in with a slight upward arc, giving a cinematic slow-motion feel at 60fps. Crisp beauty lighting, saturated candy colors, high contrast, luxurious magazine-cover aesthetic, Vogue-style fashion film, ultra-detailed fur texture, shallow depth of field, polished commercial look, 5 seconds.
